body: Names the real current shape (every hero owner-piloted, lane creeps autonomous-only, zero player unit production) and the one real precedent that exists: Tyler's own clone/drag-select system, currently hardcoded to him only. References §16.1's own honest 'sidestepped, not solved' companion-unit gap. Proposes generalizing what's real (Milestone 1: de-Tyler-ify the clone mechanism) before giving a second hero real units (Milestone 2) and real group-order vocabulary (Milestone 3); a unit-production economy named as a separate, bigger, undecided pivot (Milestone 4). Commit 6df998f.
title: NORTHSTAR §24: full unit control affordances (Warcraft 3), spec only
